sources.title: Plans for 40MW Dorking battery storage plant face local resident objection
paragraphs: More than forty local residents attended the Mole Valley planning consultation meeting to voice concerns over the proposed battery energy storage system near Dorking substation, citing fire safety, emergency water runoff, and heavy construction traffic along narrow rural lanes.

A spokesperson for the developer noted that the facility utilizes modern lithium iron phosphate chemistry with automated suppression systems, designed to store renewable energy and support local grid stability during peak demand.

sources.title: Surrey battery scheme planning submission receives parish council feedback
paragraphs: The local parish council voted to submit neutral comments subject to comprehensive acoustic screening, noting that inverter hum and visual impact on the green belt buffer must be mitigated with dense native hedgerow planting.
